answers.title: Kestrel Field Notes 1.0 — a field notebook that works without signal
answers.text:
Kestrel Field Notes 1.0 is here

Kestrel Field Notes is a notebook app for people who work outdoors: ecologists, surveyors, geologists and field crews.

Works with no signal

Write notes, sketch and take photos with no connection at all. Everything syncs on its own the moment you are back in range.

Every photo knows where it was taken

Photos are tagged with GPS location and time, and pinned on a map of your site.

From the field to the report

Export a day's notes to CSV or PDF in two taps.

Pricing

Free for up to 3 projects. Kestrel Pro is $6 a month for unlimited projects and team sharing.

Available today for iOS and Android.
